message: surface_coverage: OK — 4 surface(s) (ok=4 debt=0 gap=0) scope_partial=true groups=[state]
help:
surface_coverage
================
Every security surface a project DECLARES under proof/surfaces/*.yaml must carry
a disposition with a reason: reviewed, not_applicable, or accepted_risk.

  GAP  — declared surface with no disposition (pending)
  DEBT — accepted_risk, a disposition missing its reason, or detection drift
  OK   — reviewed or not_applicable, with a reason

Green matrix ≠ zero bugs; it means every declared surface has been dispositioned.
Dual-surface rows (enforce ≡ project) may not be quieted by accepted_risk alone.

The check is inert until a project declares surfaces. Declare one:

  # proof/surfaces/<group>.yaml
  surfaces:
    - id: admin.require_superuser
      description: Admin mutations must require a superuser
      location: { paths: [src/admin/**] }
      detect:  { method: annotation, annotation: "surface:admin.require_superuser" }
      disposition: { status: reviewed, reason: "Enforced + tested", ref: STK-REQ-12/AC-3 }

Docs: proof help surface_coverage
Close GAPs: proof role show surface-close --format agent
